contexts.text: When something happened to me which appeared to be fortuitous, I was told by the Angels that it happened because such Spirits were present... And when anything prevails which is contrary to (the Providence of the Lord) things unfortunate happen.
Natural good... may exist by things which happen...
A dead thing... may indeed in many ways be... changed by external accidents...
That all evil, even accidental, comes from Hell.
The things which are... provided by God... with men who trust in themselves, and indulge the loves of self and of the world, are at once turned into evils; and even into accidents.
That whatever evil happens, even the least, comes from evil Spirits. (See Evil Spirit.)
